Overview

The economics of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Healthcare & Life Sciences flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into EHR integration without inventing a shadow estate. For Healthcare & Life Sciences, the design tension is specific — clinical reality on one side, HIPAA / HITECH on the other, and a control environment that must survive both internal audit and external inspection. We build for that tension explicitly rather than discovering it at gate review.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
The ways programs like this die — and the guard we ship against each:

items: On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
